incident_actions.note: instance.restart is the action the oom-guard-01 rule maps to; it removes the load named above

incident_explanation: ram_used_bytes is at 96.3% of ram_total_bytes, and one instance holds 14.6% of the node's RAM by itself. That points at a single workload rather than fleet-wide pressure, so acting on that instance addresses the breach without touching the node.
